query: DELETE FROM archive_index_jobs WHERE archive_id IN (SELECT j.archive_id FROM archive_index_jobs j JOIN archives a ON a.id = j.archive_id WHERE a.repo_id = $1 AND j.status = 'done' AND GREATEST(j.finished_at, j.last_accessed_at) < $2 ORDER BY j.archive_id LIMIT $3) AND status = 'done' AND GREATEST(finished_at, last_accessed_at) < $2 RETURNING archive_id
